messages:
Maria R.: @channel scheduling CobaltBridge dedicated/private cutover for Wed 03:00 UTC. Need final ack from infra/ops. Model runtime v2.14.0 pinned for this rollout; fallback v2.13.8 available. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/CB-2.14.0. Plan: tenant slices 1->4, 15m gaps, canary first. Rollback criteria: error rate >1.2% sustained 5m OR p95 latency >320ms -> immediate rollback. KMS rotation planned 02:45 UTC — confirm no collision with cutover.

DeployBot: deploy scheduled by Maria R. -> canary slice=1. Jobs queued: canary->slice1. Starting when infra gives green.

Kenji T.: Ops - KMS: rotation is at 02:45, that collides with the 03:00 cutover. Recommend either pin key or delay rotation. Maria, want to move rollout or we pin?

Maria R.: Good catch. Ops, can you pin the KMS key or shift rotation? We prefer not to move the change window; pinning would be ideal.

OpsOnCall: I'll pin the key by 02:20. ETA ~15–20m. Will post confirmation here when done. No service impact expected.

Evan L.: QA here. Smoke + integration suites for the canary are ready. Canary job uses `smoke/cb_canary.yaml`. If canary is healthy for 10m, we ramp slices 2-4 at 25%/50%/100% respectively.

ProductQA: Small note: local hallucination eval on v2.14.0 shows a +0.6% delta vs v2.13.8 on short prompts. Not a hard blocker but flagging for monitoring.

Maria R.: Noted. We'll watch quality metrics. Action: if quality regression >1.0% on our eval set, halt and fallback to v2.13.8. Ops, confirm fallback route and rollback button ready.

Sasha M.: Ops - confirm automatic fallback path exists and is tested. Which variant will we reroute traffic to?

Kenji T.: Confirmed. Fallback route -> v2.13.8 (same region). Rollback command is `rb -customer cobaltbridge --to v2.13.8`. DeployBot can trigger rollback automatically on threshold, but we'll keep manual override enabled for final confirmation.

DeployBot: Canary slice 1 deploy started -> cg-dedicated-cb1. Status: initiated. Logs: `deploybot://runs/3345679999/1`.

DeployBot: Canary slice 1 deploy succeeded. Health checks: errors 0.10%, p95 latency 210ms. Starting 10m canary observation window.

ProductQA: Canary observation at 12m: no spike on eval set, smoke tests pass. Recommend proceed to slice 2.

Maria R.: Approve. Proceeding to slice 2. Kenji please start slice 2 with ramp 25%.

Kenji T.: Starting slice 2 ramp to 25% now.

DeployBot: slice2 ramp to 25% started. Link: `deploybot://runs/3345679999/2`.

OpsOnCall: Monitoring dashboards. Noting a small CPU bump on GPU hosts; autoscaler launched one extra node, within expected limits so far.

Sasha M.: Reminder to add note in release docs: quantization profile changed in v2.14.0 — clients with pinned profiles may need update.

Maria R.: Added quantization note to release docs and internal rollout checklist.

DeployBot: slice3 deploy initiated.

DeployBot: ALERT: slice3 error rate crossed threshold -> 1.4% sustained for 6m (threshold 1.2% for 5m). Initiating rollback for affected slice(s) to v2.13.8 now.

OpsOnCall: Acknowledged. Watching logs and tracing. Pausing any further ramps. Will collect GPU traces and metrics.

Kenji T.: Thanks — DeployBot initiated rollback as planned. Please save logs and create an incident ticket for follow-up. We should also freeze slice4.

Maria R.: Good catch by automation. Freeze slice4 and hold further rollout until postmortem. Schedule follow-up with model team and infra tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Evan, ProductQA, capture failing prompts for regression test.

Evan L.: QA will run targeted regression harness against the failing prompt set and push results to the ticket.

DeployBot: rollback complete for slice3. Status: stable. Current state: slices 1-3 traffic back to v2.13.8, slice4 paused. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-3372. Logs: `deploybot://runs/3345679999/rollback`.

Maria R.: Thank you everyone. Postmortem owners: Kenji (ops), Sasha (release notes), Evan (QA). We’ll reconvene after initial analysis. For now, rolling back was the right move.
